Before a risky edit, pair get_change_risk (defect score for a commit or base..head range) with get_blast_radius (workspace-wide impact); get_risk PR-mode leads with a directive — read may_break / missing_cochanges / tests_to_run first (tests_to_run_basis=measured means proven linkage; inferred is naming-only). get_reference_sites takes target=SYMBOL NAME (not a path); preview_symbol_rename previews a rename's site list.
